app_info.subtitle: Plan eco workdays
app_info.description: Sustainable Workday Planner helps digital nomads find published sustainable directory listings, inspect listing details, and build a practical workday itinerary across cafes, workspaces, meals, and activities.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches published directory listings and returns matching references without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one published directory listing by id or slug and returns its details without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads published listing candidates and computes an itinerary without saving or modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders a provided itinerary into the app widget without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Search for sustainable listings in a city.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find sustainable coworking and cafe options in Chiang Mai.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching sustainable directory listings with names and listing URLs.

test_cases.description: Fetch details for a known listing.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me details for Pun Pun Organic Farm and Restaurant.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the listing description, location context, website when available, and sustainability metadata.

test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a sustainable workday in Chiang Mai from 9 AM to 6 PM with a balanced work style.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an itinerary with timed stops, reasons for each stop, and any notices about missing listing coverage.

test_cases.user_prompt: Build a quiet budget-friendly sustainable workday in Bangkok with vegetarian food if possible.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a city-specific itinerary that favors quiet, budget-aware, and dietary preference matches where listings support them.

test_cases.description: Render a planned itinerary as a widget.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show that workday plan as an interactive itinerary.
test_cases.expected_output: Displays the sustainable workday itinerary widget with the same stops, timing, reasons, and notices from the plan.

test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a sustainable workday in a city where there may not be enough listings.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the best available itinerary and clearly notes missing categories, coordinates, or opening hours instead of failing silently.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for booking requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a coworking desk for tomorrow and pay the deposit.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for booking or payment actions because it only searches, fetches, plans, and renders read-only itinerary data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel logistics.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the cheapest flight from Bangkok to Tokyo next week.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because flight search is outside the sustainable directory and workday itinerary workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for authenticated account changes.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Update my profile and save this itinerary to my account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for profile updates or saved plans because v1 has no authentication or writeback.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated productivity planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a task list for my software sprint planning meeting.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is not about sustainable directory listings or workday itineraries.
